heading: What Makes Up a Credit Score
text:
## What Makes Up a Credit Score
A credit score, typically ranging from 300 to 850, is calculated from five
main factors:
- Payment history (35%) — the single most important factor; paying bills
  on time consistently builds credit over time
- Credit utilization (30%) — the percentage of available credit currently
  in use; keeping utilization below 30% is generally recommended
- Length of credit history (15%) — older accounts in good standing help
  the score
- Credit mix (10%) — having different types of credit (credit cards,
  installment loans) demonstrates the ability to manage varied obligations
- New credit inquiries (10%) — multiple new credit applications in a short
  period can temporarily lower a score

heading: Credit Score Ranges
text:
## Credit Score Ranges
- Excellent: 750 and above
- Good: 670–749
- Fair: 580–669
- Poor: below 580

heading: How Credit Building Loans Help
text:
## How Credit Building Loans Help
A credit building loan is a small installment loan structured specifically
to report on-time payments to all three major credit bureaus every month.
Because payment history is the largest single factor in a credit score,
consistent on-time payments on a credit building loan can meaningfully
improve a score over the loan's term, typically 12 to 36 months.

heading: Common Ways to Improve a Credit Score
text:
## Common Ways to Improve a Credit Score
- Pay all bills on time, every time — this has the single largest impact
- Keep credit card balances well below their limits
- Avoid opening several new credit accounts in a short window
- Keep older accounts open and in good standing, even if rarely used
- Regularly check credit reports for errors and dispute inaccuracies

heading: Does checking my rate affect my credit score?
text:
## Does checking my rate affect my credit score?
No. Pre-qualification uses a soft credit check, which does not affect your
credit score. A hard credit check only happens if you proceed with a full
application after pre-qualifying.

heading: What credit score do I need?
text:
## What credit score do I need?
Cashew Capital's minimum credit score for pre-qualification is 580.
Applicants with scores above 720 typically receive the most competitive
rates. Applicants between 580 and 669 are considered "Fair" credit and may
still qualify, generally at higher rates within the stated ranges.

heading: Can I pay off my loan early?
text:
## Can I pay off my loan early?
Yes. Cashew Capital does not charge prepayment penalties on any loan
product. Paying off a loan early reduces the total interest paid.

heading: What can a personal loan be used for?
text:
## What can a personal loan be used for?
Personal loans can be used for any legitimate personal purpose, including
home improvements, medical expenses, major purchases, or other personal
expenses. Debt consolidation loans are specifically intended for paying off
existing revolving debt (such as credit cards).

heading: How is my interest rate determined?
text:
## How is my interest rate determined?
Interest rates are determined by a combination of credit score, verified
income, requested loan amount, and loan term. There is no way to guarantee
a specific rate before applying, but applicants can get a rate estimate
through pre-qualification.

heading: What happens after I'm pre-qualified?
text:
## What happens after I'm pre-qualified?
After pre-qualification, applicants can choose to submit a full application.
The full application includes a hard credit check and requires income
verification documents. Final loan terms are confirmed at this stage.

heading: Is Cashew Capital a real financial institution?
text:
## Is Cashew Capital a real financial institution?
No. Cashew Capital is a fictional demonstration application built for
sales engineering and technical demo purposes. No real loans, credit
decisions, or funds are involved.

heading: Cashew Capital — Rates and Loan Terms
text: # Cashew Capital — Rates and Loan Terms

heading: Personal Loans
text:
## Personal Loans
Personal loans start from 6.99% APR for qualified applicants. Loan amounts
range from $1,000 to $50,000. Terms range from 24 to 60 months. Rates are
determined by credit score, income, and requested loan amount. Applicants
with a credit score above 720 typically qualify for rates at the lower end
of the range. There are no prepayment penalties and no hidden origination
fees.

heading: Debt Consolidation Loans
text:
## Debt Consolidation Loans
Debt consolidation loans start from 5.99% APR, the lowest rate tier Cashew
Capital offers, reflecting the lower risk of paying down existing revolving
debt. Loan amounts range from $2,000 to $75,000. Terms range from 24 to 84
months. Funds are typically used to pay off multiple credit card balances
directly, consolidating them into a single fixed monthly payment.

heading: Credit Building Loans
text:
## Credit Building Loans
Credit building loans start from 8.99% APR. These are smaller loans, ranging
from $500 to $5,000, with terms of 12 to 36 months. Credit building loans are
structured specifically to report positive payment history to all three
major credit bureaus each month, making them a common choice for applicants
looking to establish or rebuild credit history rather than access a large
sum of money.

heading: General Pre-Qualification Criteria
text:
## General Pre-Qualification Criteria
Pre-qualification does not affect your credit score (a soft credit check is
used). To pre-qualify, applicants generally need:
- A minimum credit score of 580 (higher scores unlock better rates)
- Verifiable income (employment, self-employment, or other regular income)
- A debt-to-income ratio below 50%

Pre-qualification is not a guarantee of final approval. Final approval
depends on a full application and hard credit check.

heading: Funding Timeline
text:
## Funding Timeline
Once approved, funds are typically deposited directly to the applicant's
bank account within one business day.
